data.title: New 3D-printed robotic hand uses low-cost parts to mimic human motion
data.description: NJIT researchers have developed a 3D-printed robotic hand that aims to deliver dexterity without the cost of commercial models.
data.author: Aamir Khollam
data.keywords: 3d printing, Cong Wang, dexterous robotics, Humanoid robots, Neel Adwani, NJIT, Robot Actuators, robotic grippers, Robotic Hands, robotic manipulation, Robotics
